business_summary: Yasuda Logistics Corporation engages in the logistics and real estate businesses in Japan. It offers logistics centers and delivery services, including warehouses and logistics centers, transport and delivery services, and supply chain solutions; medical logistics comprising pharmaceuticals, healthcare products, medical devices, reagents, and diagnostic drug logistics; IT equipment logistics services, such as IT equipment kitting, IT equipment lifecycle management, server relocation, and IT equipment maintenance and delivery services; international logistics services that include international transport network, marine transport, airport transport, logistics, and third country transport services, as well as customs clearance services; and document storage and relocation solutions consists of document storage, retrieval, and digitalization services, as well as one-stop moving services. The company is also involved in the real estate business that include office buildings, and residential leasing; redevelopment of hotel and retail facilities; operation of parking lots; and provision of building maintenance services. Yasuda Logistics Corporation was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Yasuda Logistics Corporation은 일본에서 물류 및 부동산 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 창고 및 물류 센터, 운송 및 배송 서비스, 공급망 솔루션을 포함한 물류 센터 및 배송 서비스를 제공합니다. 의약품, 헬스케어 제품, 의료 기기, 시약, 진단 약물 물류로 구성된 의료 물류; IT 장비 키트링, IT 장비 수명주기 관리, 서버 이전, IT 장비 유지 관리 및 배송 서비스 등의 IT 장비 물류 서비스 국제운송망, 해상운송, 공항운송, 물류, 제3국 운송 서비스 및 통관 서비스를 포함하는 국제물류 서비스; 문서 보관 및 이전 솔루션은 문서 보관, 검색, 디지털화 서비스와 원스톱 이동 서비스로 구성됩니다. 회사는 또한 사무실 건물, 주거용 임대 등 부동산 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 호텔 및 소매 시설 재개발; 주차장 운영; 건물 유지관리 서비스 제공. Yasuda Logistics Corporation은 1919년에 설립되었으며 본사입니다.
